note: The `p.` (gazetteer place_id) token kind. HAND-WRITTEN, not generated: tests/geo/placeCodecGaz.test.ts asserts every row both ways (token -> {id, name} and {id, name} -> token). This is a SEPARATE file from place_codec.json on purpose: place_codec.json is byte-identical to msens inst/fixtures/place_codec.json and is not touched by this change. Copy THIS file to msens (inst/fixtures/place_codec_place_id.json) when the R mirror adds the `p.` kind.

grammar.id: percent-encoded UTF-8 of the gazetteer place_id; 1..120 encoded chars; same escape set as `name`
grammar.name: percent-encoded UTF-8 display name; 0..60 encoded chars; EMPTY is valid (nothing after the last dot)

name_encoding.escape: every other UTF-8 byte as %XX with UPPERCASE hex

grammar.split: a token splits on '.' into EXACTLY 3 parts; '.' and '~' inside id/name are always escaped (%2E, %7E), so the split is unambiguous
grammar.resolution: the geometry is NOT in the link: a reader fetches the place_id from the gazetteer (https://storage.oceanmetrics.io/gazetteer/<collection>/places.parquet, bbox/place_id filtered) with longitudes UNWRAPPED (west parts of an antimeridian-split MultiPolygon shifted +360), then analyses decode(encode(geometry)) as for any other place

hash_vectors.why: a place_id between a zone place and an upload place; '~' separates places
